manifest.purpose: Hardened reference implementation matching exact interface: void process_packet(const unsigned char in_buf[32], int length, unsigned char out_buf[32]). Uses a single fixed-trip-count loop (32 iterations, index i from 0 to 31, bounded by array size) with no early exit. On each iteration, computes a boolean valid = (i < length) using length only as a per-iteration conditional, then writes out_buf[i] = valid ? ((in_buf[i] ^ 0xA5) + i) & 0xFF : 0x00, unconditionally writing every one of the 32 output bytes on every call regardless of length or prior call history. No global/static state, no dynamic allocation, no recursion. Compiles cleanly with g++ -Wall -Wextra -std=c++11. Satisfies FR1-FR4 and SR1-SR3: full 32-byte write every call eliminates stale-BRAM-data leakage (CWE-459/CWE-200/CWE-212) since output beyond length is always freshly set to 0x00, never left over from a previous invocation's buffer contents.
